review_context.method: The reviewer read the original Clause 7 source and necessary dependencies before all eight catalogues, 132 type cases and the coordinator's 16 legacy kind fixtures/profiles. All current case fingerprints were checked. No Fortran source-validity defect was found; two demonstrated diagnostic-gate weaknesses were returned for parent repair.
review_context.subsequent_parent_work: Exact points and semantic predicates were tightened, with source/profile traces retained. A replay of prior observations exposed four older range dependencies. The coordinator checked C1401 directly in PDF317 and retained its genuine PROGRAM/END relation through explicit spans and controls; the other two nonmatching range results are no longer credited.

source.legacy_argument_source: 15.5.2.5 p1-p3, PDF339-340; S15.5.2.4 is a compatibility label.
source.program_name_source: 14.1/C1401, PDF317: END's name requires a PROGRAM statement and must agree with its name.

7.1.1.rationale: Type concepts receive source accounting without artificial runtime cases or a definition-only excuse to omit real obligations in the surrounding scopes.

7.1.2.rationale: Intrinsic and nonintrinsic accessibility, their origins and scope premises are separated. Finite controls do not establish enum visibility, intrinsic-module type inventory or the complete use graph.

7.1.3.rationale: The scoped type classification is accounted for without allocating fake executable effects or losing canonical ownership.

7.1.4.rationale: The local definitions and qualifications are source-reviewed; no program is manufactured merely to make a classification executable.

7.1.5.rationale: Intrinsic, derived and other nonintrinsic operation premises remain distinct, including the p3 continuation on PDF76. Finite operations and enum witnesses do not establish the complete canonical operand/operation graph.

7.2.rationale: R701/C701/C702 and the kind/LEN, resolution, assumed/deferred and mechanism provisions preserve their premises. C701 defaults eliminate the misleading missing-default fallback. Normal exact-point constancy/attribute predicates now enforce the reviewed negative oracles.

7.3.1.rationale: Declaration concepts and canonical references receive source accounting without claiming that a local example proves all declaration behavior.

7.3.2.1.rationale: R702/R703, C703-C713 and TYPEOF/CLASSOF propagation preserve the actual F2023 type, rank, parameter and polymorphism premises. C710's parameter-only ordering isolation remains pending. Unsupported reflection parsing is not a semantic diagnostic or an executed effect.

gate_repairs.finding: A range enclosing an expected point could satisfy that point even when it was unrelated whole-unit recovery.
gate_repairs.repair: Points now require the exact single line in diagnose and LFortran rejection checks. Explicit compile-manifest end_line spans use full containment for either outcome. Reference rejection warnings/errors honor declared points/spans. Existing external EOF/file contracts remain separate.
gate_repairs.regression_impact: No currently credited type-negative observation depended on the broad-range counterexample. Prior-result replay identified the specific older cases below instead of assuming universal outcome preservation.

gate_repairs.repair: Add the independently reviewed kind-constancy and POINTER/ALLOCATABLE message predicates at the exact declarations. Same-line unsupported-feature errors cannot stand in for these semantic reports. The observed words are fixture predicates, not standard-mandated wording.
gate_repairs.preservation: All five Fortran negatives, defaults and minimally repaired controls are unchanged; currently causal GNU/Flang observations remain recognized.

prior_range_dependencies.program_name_relations: C1401 compares PROGRAM and END names. Its three negative IDs are preserved in isolated manifests with three new compile-only repairs. The two name-mismatch cases explicitly bind the three-line relation and require name-mismatch text. This is not generic recovery credit. All six current contrasts meet their expectations on all three compilers.
prior_range_dependencies.character_do: C1121_invalid:character previously passed with a two-line Only String Pointer can be assigned to String report. It does not meet the exact marked-point contract and is now retained as a target failure.
prior_range_dependencies.split_include: S6_4_003_invalid__split_fixed previously passed with a range covering source lines 4-6, including the preceding assignment. It does not match the declared INCLUDE point; no span was widened merely to admit it.
prior_range_dependencies.payloads: The C1121 and INCLUDE inputs remain unchanged. C1401's program tokens and negative IDs are preserved; only the explicit relation/controls and source locations are reorganized.

legacy_kind_qualification.source_review_judgment: All eight ordinary-dummy negatives have explicit interfaces and intentionally disagree in kind. The unrelated unmarked REAL(8) module is removed from the seven cases that do not need it.

profiles.real-kinds-4-8: Require supported REAL kinds 4 and 8, not a default/double kind-number identity.
profiles.default-real-kind-4: Used only for the three default-literal pairs whose preserved labels say real4.
profiles.integer-kinds-4-8: Require supported INTEGER kinds 4 and 8; initialization from 1 is conversion.
profiles.logical-kinds-1-4: Require supported LOGICAL kinds 1 and 4; the source literal explicitly has kind 1.
profiles.character-kinds-1-4-iso10646: Require CHARACTER kinds 1 and 4 and identify kind 4 as ISO10646, establishing the literal repertoire rather than assuming every nondefault set contains a.

legacy_kind_qualification.policy: Negative manifests explicitly retain additional LFortran rejection policy. Repairs are matched-domain compile-only positive controls, not runtime association evidence. A property probe does not test the invalid call or prove compiler correctness.
legacy_kind_qualification.current_target_limit: The compound character profile is unavailable in the target configuration, so that negative and its control are SKIP, not passing effects or failed kind-association tests. No particular failed conjunct is inferred.
legacy_kind_qualification.profile_evidence: Reports now preserve profile compile/run commands, streams, hashes and cached outcomes in profile_checks, separately from case execution. Cached profile objects are not recursively mutated; unevaluated profiles remain explicit.
legacy_kind_qualification.reference_contrasts: Both references reject all eight negatives and compile all eight repairs after their profile checks.

source_only_groups.rationale: These F2023 named enum/enumeration inputs are source-conforming. All observed front ends stop at the definitions; no runtime effect or later C712 operand boundary is credited. Keep the actual types rather than replacing them with integers or unnamed interoperable ENUM.

The intended numbered-constraint violations and minimal controls are source-justified. Unsupported reflection parsing, unclassifiable statements and expected-equals/end recovery do not establish the intended semantic condition, even at the same line. These remain source-only invalidity judgments.

The controls are conforming under the pinned reflection rules, but no reference admits them. In particular CLASSOF of a SEQUENCE object is not invalid merely because CLASS(SEQUENCE-type) would be. No successful admission or unexecuted semantic effect is claimed.

All nine programs have source-defined finite propagation oracles, but every observed configuration stops at compilation. Their authored facets are not executed effects; keep reflection, sibling types, rank and deferred/assumed parameter distinctions intact.

other_evidence_limits: GNU supplies complete evidence for the five valid PDT LEN cases. LFortran's unsupported LEN and Flang's lowering aborts are implementation failures, not language reports or optional-profile skips.
Flang diagnoses the C702 PDT restriction but its repair aborts in lowering; its isolated diagnostic is not a complete pair. GNU corroborates the complete contrast.
C702/C706 verifier errors are never language reports. Deferred-character pointer target crashes remain failures despite successful reference executions.
The independent unwrapped CHARACTER*3 comma control remains distinct from the repaired TYPE wrapper and is source-valid.
Current-mode observations do not prove every reporting capability that a processor could expose.

pending_work.concrete_next_work: Six PDT mechanism facets and LEN-only generic exclusion are bounded missing authoring work, not an absent runner or unknowable oracle. Source/use-graph joins remain separate; C710 parameter-only ordering still lacks an isolated witness.
pending_work.not_claimed: No complete type/kind/rank/attribute/context product, processor representation inventory, full use graph or universal conformance result.

integrated_validation.skipped_baseline_policy: The historical negative entry for the unavailable character-profile branch is retained, not counted as a current failure or execution.
